edges.reason: require(msg.sender == owner) gates entry to drop() based on the caller address

drop() calls isQualitifiedAddress() for every recipient
isQualitifiedAddress() calls isContract()
isContract() executes the inline assembly extcodesize operation
drop() performs an external call to token.transferFrom on an attacker-controlled token address, enabling reentrancy before available is fully decremented
transferAnyERC20Token() performs an external token.transfer to owner with no caller authorization, allowing anyone to drain contract-held tokens
tokenAddress parameter is used to construct the ERC20 token instance
msg.sender is passed to token.balanceOf and token.allowance
balance local is assigned from token.balanceOf(msg.sender)
allowance local is assigned from token.allowance(msg.sender, address(this))
available is derived from balance when balance > allowance
available is derived from allowance when allowance >= balance
available -= amounts[i] performs arithmetic on the caller-supplied amount
amounts[i] is passed directly into token.transferFrom
recipients[i] is used as the transferFrom destination
msg.sender is used as the 'from' argument of token.transferFrom
loop index i indexes into the recipients array
addr parameter is read by the extcodesize assembly block
size local receives the extcodesize return value
addr parameter is evaluated into the result return value
msg.sender is compared with addr inside isQualitifiedAddress to reject the caller
tokenAddress parameter selects the token contract for the transfer
tokens parameter is the amount transferred in transferAnyERC20Token
owner is the fixed recipient of the token transfer
recipients array drives the drop() loop
amounts array drives the drop() loop and require checks
loop counter i controls iteration inside drop()
